Can I do this job till I get any other job there? Please advise me. Question: Asalamualaikum. Is it permissible for me to work in a computer department of a bank where I have to maintain and install computers nothing else. No bank related activity. Actually im working in software company in gurgaon but im facing problems like no mosque, no friday prayers, no muslim culture thats why im planning to go back to my native place (srinagar kashmir) but currently im getting job in computer department in bank. Can I do this job till I get any other job there? Please advise me. Answer ID: 25100 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1892/H=521/th=1431) There is no problem, if you assume the job of computer maintenance,. Also, keep on trying your level best to arrange for the jumu'ah. It is strange not to have jumu’ah salah in a place like Gurgaon, build some system with the advice of local Muslims. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
